records.title: Association and intervention
records.text: A conditional association alone does not specify the outcome distribution under an intervention.
limitations: Additional causal assumptions are needed.

records.title: Intervention operator
records.text: A structural intervention replaces the treatment assignment mechanism while retaining the other stipulated mechanisms.
limitations: Observational conditioning is a different operation.

records.title: Causal directed acyclic graph
records.text: A causal DAG records directional assumptions, including meaningful absent arrows.
limitations: Drawing arrows does not verify them.

records.title: D-separation
records.text: D-separation tests whether a conditioning set blocks all paths in a stated DAG.
limitations: D-connection need not yield empirical dependence.

records.title: Collider conditioning
records.text: Conditioning on a collider or its descendant can open a previously blocked path.
limitations: More adjustment is not automatically better.

records.title: Back-door adjustment check
records.text: The standard back-door criterion excludes treatment descendants and blocks paths entering treatment.
limitations: Failure does not rule out all identification methods.

records.title: Potential outcomes
records.text: Potential outcomes describe outcomes under specified alternative treatment assignments.
limitations: Both alternatives are not observed for one unit.

records.title: Target population and contrast
records.text: Population-average comparisons depend on the population distribution used to combine strata.
limitations: Changing weights can change the target.

records.title: Conditional exchangeability
records.locator: The randomised experiment paradigm for observational studies
records.text: Within declared covariate strata, treatment groups are assumed comparable in their potential outcomes.
limitations: Observed balance cannot establish this assumption.
records.equation: Y(a) independent of A given L

records.title: Standardized contrast
records.text: Combine stratum-specific outcome rates using a common target-population distribution.
limitations: Arithmetic alone establishes no causal effect.

records.title: Identification versus estimation
records.locator: Confounding and identifiability of causal effects
records.text: Observed distributions can support different causal effects when identifying assumptions are absent.
limitations: A precise estimate cannot repair nonidentification.

records.title: Consistency for a defined treatment
records.text: Observed outcomes correspond to the potential outcome under the treatment actually received.
limitations: Do not merge materially different interventions.

records.title: Positivity and support
records.text: Adjustment needs treatment support in covariate strata carrying target-population weight.
limitations: A fitted probability cannot create missing support.

records.title: Inverse-probability weighting
records.text: Weight observations by reciprocals of their treatment-assignment probabilities to reweight the comparison.
assumptions: Appropriate probability model and causal assumptions.
limitations: Weights do not correct unmeasured confounding automatically.

records.title: Weight diagnostics
records.text: Extreme weights motivate support and model diagnostics; truncation trades bias against precision.
limitations: Do not silently clip inconvenient weights.

records.title: Treatment-confounder feedback
records.text: Earlier treatment can affect later confounders, requiring methods suited to longitudinal structure.
limitations: A baseline-only adjustment may not address this.

records.title: Specify a target trial
records.text: Specify eligibility, strategies, assignment, follow-up, outcome, contrast, and analysis before emulation.
limitations: A completed template does not establish identification.

records.title: Align time zero
records.text: Align eligibility, treatment-strategy assignment, and follow-up start to avoid inappropriate selection.
limitations: Future information must not define baseline eligibility.

records.title: Baseline eligibility
records.text: Postbaseline events should not retroactively determine eligibility for the baseline trial.
limitations: Selection can alter the intended comparison.

records.title: Assignment and adherence contrasts
records.locator: Causal contrast(s) of interest; Analysis plan
records.text: Assignment effects and effects of following a strategy are distinct causal questions.
limitations: Observed initiators are not automatically randomized groups.

records.title: Outcome ascertainment
records.text: How outcomes are recorded can depend on treatment and change the estimand or introduce bias.
assumptions: Specify the outcome and measurement process.
limitations: Recorded outcomes need validation.

records.title: Negative-control outcome
records.locator: Conditions for negative controls; discussion surrounding Figure 2
records.text: A suitable control outcome shares relevant bias pathways but is not caused by the exposure.
limitations: Unexpected association is a diagnostic, not automatic proof.

records.title: Negative-control exposure
records.text: A suitable control exposure shares relevant bias pathways without causing the studied outcome.
assumptions: Justify the exclusion and comparability assumptions.
limitations: An arbitrary unrelated exposure may be uninformative.

records.title: Limits of null controls
records.text: A null control association can miss confounding pathways not shared by that control.
limitations: A null result does not certify absence of bias.
